- whether you'll run the test from a private VPC or our hosted endpoint (this affects routing/fallback config)

Attached: prompt-set-v1.json, load-test-plan.xlsx

Connor — which option works best? If you pick live, pick one of the slots and we'll lock it. If async, we'll send the packet by EOD today and propose a 30-min sync next week.
